tasks.title: Extract and fetch raw work image sources into docs/private/work
tasks.description: Add `scripts/extract-work-sources.mjs` and an npm script `work:sources`. It decodes the base64 JPEGs embedded in the gitignored `docs/private/eric-lingren-impact.html` and writes them to `docs/private/work//.jpg`. A mapping table inside the script assigns each `` to a slug by its alt text or order, never by line number: kpi-granularity gets 2 images (per-KPI granularity configure UI, adding company-specific metrics), investor-reports gets 4 (masthead before, masthead after, footer progress tracker, auto-submit state), metrics-tab-v2 gets 1 (focused cell plus Datum Tracer). The 4 images that belong to sections not on the panel (Scenarios, Metrics Repository) are skipped. The script also downloads the 3 v1 Lighthouse reports of dev.insideoutdev.com (dated 10-28-21, 10-29-21 and 11-1-21) into `docs/private/work/render-performance/`. Their URLs are the three user-images.githubusercontent.com entries in the v1 site's work data: run `git show v1-legacy:src/components/standard/work/workData.js` and read the 'Website Render Optimizations' entry (about lines 248-264). All three returned HTTP 200 when fetched during the grill. Use descriptive file names that carry the date, for example `lighthouse-2021-10-28.png`. The script is idempotent (reruns overwrite the same names), never writes outside `docs/private/` (already gitignored via `/docs/private/`), and takes the HTML path and the fetch function as injectable arguments so tests need no network. Run it once as part of this task and list the produced files in the log.
acceptance_criteria: Test: a fixture HTML with 3 tiny base64 JPEGs mapped to slugs plus 1 unmapped section image writes the 3 mapped images to the expected slug paths, skips the unmapped one, and the decoded bytes equal the fixture bytes.
Test: with an injected fetch, 3 Lighthouse URLs are written to docs/private/work/render-performance/; a non-200 response fails with a message that names the URL. No test touches the real network.
Test: every output path resolves under docs/private/work, and a mapping entry with a path-traversal slug is rejected.
`npm run work:sources` has been run once: docs/private/work holds 7 images from the HTML and 3 Lighthouse PNGs, and `git status` lists none of them.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass.
tasks.summary: Added scripts/extract-work-sources.mjs (alt-text mapping, injectable html path and fetch, slug and path-traversal guards, idempotent) plus the work:sources npm script and 15 tests. Ran it once: 7 HTML images and 3 Lighthouse PNGs now sit in the main checkout's docs/private/work, and git status lists none of them.

tasks.title: Build WebP thumbnails and detail images from a crop manifest
tasks.description:
Add `scripts/build-work-images.mjs` (npm script `work:images`) driven by `scripts/work-images.manifest.json`. For each slug the manifest lists outputs: source file (relative to `docs/private/work`), crop rect `{left, top, width, height}`, output name, and kind `thumb` or `detail`.

- thumb: crop, resize to 568x284 (2:1 at 2x), write WebP to `public/work/<slug>/thumb.webp`.
- detail: full-size WebP at `public/work/<slug>/<name>.webp`, max width 1600, never upscaled, aspect ratio kept.
- Write `src/content/work-images.json` mapping each published path (for example `/work/<slug>/<file>`) to `{width, height}`. `<Figure>` and `<BeforeAfter>` read it.
- Metadata is stripped and output is deterministic. The script fails on a missing source, an out-of-bounds crop rect, or a thumb rect that is not 2:1 (1px tolerance).

Fill the manifest for the 4 slugs that have sources now. Agreed thumb subjects: kpi-granularity = the per-KPI granularity configure UI (650x432 shot); investor-reports = the masthead after image, cropped to its left logo and title region; metrics-tab-v2 = focused cell plus Datum Tracer; render-performance = the 10-29-21 Lighthouse report, score ring plus 4 metric rows. Detail outputs: kpi-granularity both images, investor-reports all 4 images, metrics-tab-v2 the 1 image, render-performance the 10-28-21 and 10-29-21 reports only (the 11-1-21 run has portrait frames, so it is a different preset and is not a clean comparison; do not build it, because unused files fail the orphan check).

Crop rects are tuned by eye: after each run, open every generated thumb and adjust its rect until the agreed subject reads at 284x142 CSS px. Record what each thumb shows in the log. frontend-platform is not built here; it waits for the Storybook capture (T-0043, T-0044).
acceptance_criteria: Test: a sharp-generated synthetic PNG with distinct colour quadrants produces a WebP thumb that is 568x284 and whose corner pixels match the cropped quadrant.
Test: an out-of-bounds crop, a missing source, and a thumb rect that is not 2:1 each throw an error that names the slug and output.
Test: a detail output wider than 1600 is downscaled with aspect kept, a narrower one is not upscaled, and every width/height in work-images.json equals the real output size read back with sharp.
Test: two consecutive runs give byte-identical outputs and an identical work-images.json.

`npm run work:images` has been run: public/work/{kpi-granularity,investor-reports,metrics-tab-v2,render-performance}/thumb.webp exist at 568x284, and the log records what each thumb shows after a visual check.
public/work contains only files the script produced.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass.
tasks.summary: Added scripts/build-work-images.mjs (npm run work:images) driven by scripts/work-images.manifest.json: 568x284 thumbs, detail WebPs capped at 1600 wide and never upscaled, src/content/work-images.json. Fails on missing source, out-of-bounds rect or non-2:1 thumb rect; prunes unproduced files in public/work. Built 13 images for 4 slugs. Thumbs: kpi-granularity configure table; investor-reports title+logo tile; metrics-tab-v2 focused $7,896 cell + Datum Tracer; render-performance 10-29-21 score ring + metric grid.

tasks.title: Redesign Selected Work cards: 3+2 image-top on desktop, compact rows on phone
tasks.description:

Markup and CSS (`SelectedWork.tsx`, `selected-work.css`):
- Desktop (container wide enough for 3 across, about 720px and up; 1440x900 gives about 893px): 3 cards on the first row and 2 centred on the second. Each card is image on top at aspect-ratio 2/1 (about 284x142 CSS px), then title, outcome clamped to 2 lines, then the optional card number.
- Tablet widths between the phone and desktop breakpoints: 2 across with the same image-top card. This was an assumption in the grill, not confirmed by Eric, so note it in the log for his tablet check.
- Phone (container under 560px): compact rows. The same 2:1 crop shows at about 112x56 on the left, title and card number on the right, outcome clamped to 2 lines. Same markup, CSS-only switch. Reconcile this with the existing 600px media query that shrinks the type.

- All cards use the shared `.card` rules only. No image zoom, no per-card effect, no new motion.

Fit: at 1440x900 the card grid has roughly 580px of room before the panel scales down through --content-fit; the 3+2 layout must stay inside it. On a 390x844 phone, 5 rows must also fit without scaling. Keep the existing SelectedWork tests green: 5 `a.work-card` in slug order with `data-card` and `href`, the geometry test, and the `.card:hover` / `.card:active` selectors in globals.css.
acceptance_criteria: Test: with all thumbs present, SelectedWork renders 5 a.work-card in slug order, each thumb img has width=568, height=284, loading=lazy, decoding=async and alt="", and the ul has role=list.
Test: the sketch-versus-polished geometry test and the .card:hover / .card:active assertions still pass.

tasks.description:

tasks.title: Add work-image checks and a per-slug word floor to the strict content gate
tasks.description:
In `scripts/check-content.mjs`, with tests in `scripts/check-content.test.mjs`, add strict-mode rules:
1. `work-thumbnail-missing`: every card in `src/content/work-cards.json` has its thumbnail file in `public/`. Missing is a failure, not a silent empty frame. Only the panel cards (CARD_SLUGS) are checked; ai-toolkit is out of scope.
2. `work-figure`: in `content/work/*.mdx`, every `<Figure>` has non-empty alt and caption and a src that exists in `public/` and in work-images.json; every `<BeforeAfter>` has before, after, beforeAlt, afterAlt and caption with existing files.
3. `work-orphan`: every file under `public/work/` is referenced by a card thumbnail or a Figure/BeforeAfter src, and every work-images.json entry has a file. Follow the testimonials orphan check at about lines 155-197.
4. `work-internal-url`: no Slack, Linear or Notion URLs (including standard-metrics.slack.com, linear.app, app.notion.com) and no github.com/Quaestor-Technologies links in `content/work/*.mdx` or `work-cards.json`.
5. A regression test that a `cardOutcome` containing an `[ERIC:` marker is already flagged by the existing marker rule. No new rule code.

Word floor: replace the single `WORD_MIN = 600` with `WORD_MIN_OVERRIDES` (a slug-to-number map, empty to start) so the word-count check uses `override ?? 600`. The per-page interviews add a 450 entry only when cuts push a page under 600. The per-slug test files that assert 600-900 words read the same map. The empty-frame fallback stays in the component for dev; this gate keeps it from shipping.
acceptance_criteria: Test: a card whose thumbnail file is missing fails work-thumbnail-missing in strict mode; ai-toolkit's missing thumb does not.
Test: a Figure with empty alt, no caption, or a src not in public/ or work-images.json fails work-figure; a BeforeAfter missing afterAlt fails.
Test: an unreferenced file in public/work and a work-images.json entry with no file each fail work-orphan.
Test: Slack, Linear, Notion and Quaestor-Technologies URLs in work MDX or work-cards.json fail work-internal-url.
Test: a work-cards.json cardOutcome containing [ERIC: is flagged; a slug in WORD_MIN_OVERRIDES with 450 words passes while the same count fails without the override.
`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass.
tasks.summary: Added work-thumbnail-missing, work-figure, work-orphan and work-internal-url strict rules to check-content.mjs; replaced single word floor with WORD_MIN_OVERRIDES (empty) plus wordMinFor(slug), read by the six per-slug work tests. Real strict run currently reports expected work-thumbnail-missing (frontend-platform), 7 work-orphan (unreferenced detail images) and the render-performance cardOutcome eric-marker.
